name: Pincushion cactus
desc: Pincushion cactus (Pelecyphora vivipara): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 4 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Pelecyphora vivipara is a species of cactus known by several common names, including spinystar, viviparous foxtail cactus, pincushion cactus and ball cactus.
